technique_name: Summarize the following article in 100 words: "The Benefits of Plant-Centered Eating"
description: There are many health benefits to plant-based eating, including weight loss, lower cholesterol, and improved digestive health. Eating plants can help the environment, as it produces fewer emissions and requires fewer resources than animal-based diets. Plant-based diets can also help reduce the risk of certain diseases and chronic illnesses.
